basic_info.description: Amazing Noe Valley fully entitled development opportunity. The plans call for 2 distinct luxury residences spanning 4 levels and 5972+/- sq ft. on an oversized lot. Each home features 3 bedrooms / 3.5 baths, spacious entertaining spaces, multiple outdoor areas, an elevator, 2 car parking and views of the bay, Noe Valley and Downtown. Centrally located on Clipper and Castro streets, 3 flat blocks to all the amenities 24th street offers.    The current updated single family home is in nice livable condition as is and measures 1470 sq ft. It comprises 3 bedrooms, 1 bath, an open plan kitchen living area, laundry, a sun drenched flat south facing garden and parking for 3 vehicles. Renders are graphic artists' impressions and may not be accurate.
